stem: A crop plan increases flowering-room throughput but drying capacity remains unchanged. What should happen before adopting the plan?
choices: Evaluate downstream harvest/drying bottlenecks and lot-hold risk as part of total system capacity
Ignore post-harvest because it occurs after cultivation
Increase plant density further to offset the bottleneck
Use cultivar finish dates as the only capacity model
rationale: Production capacity is end-to-end. Increasing upstream throughput without downstream capacity can create quality and scheduling risk.
